prompts.prompt: Which ClickHouse storage engine, introduced in the 24.8 LTS release and exclusive to ClickHouse Cloud, decouples storage from compute by keeping data in object storage with a local SSD cache? Answer with the exact engine name.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/clickhouse/references/versions/24.8-lts.md - SharedMergeTree (ClickHouse Cloud) section: cloud-native storage engine available exclusively in ClickHouse Cloud, replacing ReplicatedMergeTree for Cloud deployments.

prompts.prompt: As of ClickHouse 25.3 LTS, do you still need to set an experimental flag such as allow_experimental_variant_type before creating a table with a Variant column? Answer with yes or no.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/clickhouse/references/versions/25.3-lts.md - Variant and Dynamic Types (GA) section: no experimental flag needed in 25.3, contrasted with references/versions/24.8-lts.md which required SET allow_experimental_variant_type = 1.

prompts.prompt: In ClickHouse MergeTree tables, what is the default index_granularity value, meaning how many rows are represented by each entry in the sparse primary index? Answer with the exact number.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/clickhouse/SKILL.md - Primary Key and Sparse Index section: one index entry per index_granularity rows (default 8192).
